messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired (P1) - multiple hosts in us-west-2 reporting kernel oops / NIC reset followed by kubelet NotReady. Alert group: gpu-rack-7 - affected hosts: gpu-node-78, gpu-node-81, gpu-node-84. Pager: oncall-eng
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-112233 - escalated to primary oncall
Alex: ack. I'm on it. first quick check: are we seeing the same hardware failure across the rack or network flap?
Miguel: saw similar yesterday but isolated. pulling node logs now. running remote dmesg on gpu-node-78: `eth0: igbvf vf pf reset detected` then kernel oops stack (NIC driver).
Priya: heading in — might be a NIC firmware regression from recent vendor update. tagging infra. Can we cordon the other nodes in the rack preemptively?
Alex: yes. cordoning node-78 now.
Alex: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-78` -> Node gpu-node-78 cordoned
Jenna: starting drain for gpu-node-78: `kubectl drain gpu-node-78 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force` - evicting pods, watch for long-running inference jobs
Sam: note: a handful of Hosted inference requests in us-west-2 are getting 503s and timed-out streams. Ops alert matched latency spike on route /v1/chat/stream.
Miguel: logs from node-81 show repeated NIC reboot messages followed by `kubelet: node not ready: KubeletStopped` within 30s
Priya: escalate to hardware vendor RMA queue? hold on RMA until we confirm firmware. If it's firmware, rolling firmware rollback across rack could be needed.
Alex: quick mitigation plan: 1) cordon + drain affected nodes, 2) failover traffic to other racks in us-west-2 (routing policy), 3) spin up Dedicated fallback capacity for critical tenants if autoscaler can't keep up.
Jenna: started draining node-81 as well. Eviction count: 12 pods on node-81, 8 on node-84. Most are stateless runtime pods but a couple of long-running customer jobs - tagging solutions to warn customers.
Sam: posted incident notice to #support with initial blurb: "We are investigating degraded inference availability in us-west-2 due to node hardware/network issues. Engineers are mitigating. Impact: some requests may see 5xx/errors." Support asks for ETA on customer-facing message.
Alex: short-term ETA: 30-45m for drains + routing changes. Will update if we need to trigger cross-region failover for higher-impact customers.
Miguel: while draining did reveal kernel oops on gpu-node-84 during eviction (panic at 0xffffffff). capturing serial console and uploading log snippet: `---begin---\n[kernel] igb: link down, resetting\n[kernel] BUG: unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference\n---end---`
Priya: good capture. I'm opening an infra ticket (INFRA-4521) and pinging vendor with sysdump attached. Also adding a temporary automation rule to suppress autopager for repeat identical events on these hosts for 10m to avoid noise.
incident-bot: Incident created: INFRA-4521 - multi-node NIC/kernel oops in us-west-2. Assigned: Priya. Severity: P1.
Alex: handoff plan if I'm paged out: Priya will lead hardware/vendor triage, Miguel will handle cluster-level coordination, Jenna/Sam take customer comms and routing.
Jenna: putting a pinned status update for support and marketing: short public status: "We are mitigating an infrastructure issue affecting inference in us-west-2. Most traffic is healthy; some customers may see errors. Will update in 30m."
Sam: notifying top 5 impacted customers via SRE-runbook channel. copying mitigation steps in case they ask for hotfixes.
Priya: vendor replied - ask for kernel/firmware diff logs, they may push rollback. Meanwhile recommending we isolate affected NICs and power cycle from BMC if safe. I'll coordinate remote reboot windows.
Alex: action items summary: 1) finish drains on 78/81/84 (in progress) 2) route traffic away from rack-7 (Miguel/Jenna) 3) vendor engagement and RMA if confirmed (Priya) 4) customer comms (Jenna/Sam) 5) escalate to platform lead if duration >2h
Miguel: routing updated to reduce new allocations to rack-7, added temporary fallback route to us-west-2b. Confirming metrics: error-rate on streaming down from 8% -> 2% after initial routing.
Jenna: drains complete for 78/81; node-84 still evicting one long job. I'll hold until job completes or we force-delete at 10m.
Sam: support asked for workaround tokens for impacted customers. Noted separate approval required. filing request.
Priya: vendor suggests firmware rollback to previous stable rev. scheduling staged rollback starting with non-critical nodes outside of production rack to validate.
Alex: ok. if rollback validated, schedule for rack-7 tonight with maintenance window; otherwise RMA nodes.
Miguel: adding post-incident: add probe to detect repeated NIC resets before kubelet NotReady so we can preemptively cordon.
Jenna: updating incident timeline and tagging this thread to postmortems later.
Alex: handing off active leadership to Priya (I'm going offline in ~20m). Priya, take lead.
Priya: taking lead. will post next update once vendor attaches kernel patch/rollback validated (~45m). thanks all for quick response. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident INFRA-4521 updated: leadership transferred to Priya. Next update expected within 45 minutes.
